_help.what: All project content lives here. index.html builds the Recent Works cards from this file, and proyecto.html?id=<id> builds each case study page.
_help.id: Used in the URL: proyecto.html?id=casalia. Lowercase, no spaces. If you change it, old links stop working.
_help.card: cardColor = background of the card. cardInk = text color on it ('light' or 'dark'). cardStat = the big number or word shown on the card. cardStatLabel = small line under it. Optional: add "cardImage": "assets/images/projects/<id>/cover.jpg" to show an image on the card instead of the big number. With 'cardImage' set, the card shows the image (set cardInk to 'light' if the image is dark). Optional 'cardImagePosition' (e.g. "50% 28%") chooses which part of a tall photo shows on the card.
_help.tags: 'What I did' pill tags shown under the info row.
_help.cover: Optional big picture under the tags: { "src", "alt", "width", "height" }. Image, GIF or video (.mp4/.webm). Without a cover, the numbers banner takes its place.
_help.story: The brief explanation: optional 'headline' (big), 'subhead', 'body' (short paragraphs), optional 'images' (shown side by side, same size, after the text), then optional 'pillarsTitle' + 'pillars' [{ "title", "text" }]. Optional 'carousel' [{ "src", "alt", "width", "height" }]: a looping slider with arrows, shown after the pillars, in the order listed. Optional 'strips': a list of image rows shown after the banner. Each row keeps every image at the same height and fits the page width. Optional 'banner' { "src", "alt", "width", "height" }: one full-width image right after the carousel. Optional 'masonry': a compact photo gallery in columns (like a photographer's grid), shown after the text and proposal. Optional 'worksTitle' + 'works' [{ "title", "year", "category", "text", "credits": [..], "url", "cta", "image" }]: a list of external projects (e.g. Readymag) that open in a new tab. Optional 'journalTitle' + 'journal' [{ "src", "alt", "width", "height", "caption" }]: a black, full-width photo journal, one centered column. Optional 'split' { "title", "columns": [{ "heading", "items": [..] }] }: side-by-side 'who did what' columns, after the text. Pillars can also have "key", "role" (small label), "color" and "chips" [..]. Optional 'process' { "title", "steps": [{ "title", "text" }], "result": { "value", "label" } }: method steps after the pillars. Optional 'formats' { "title", "text", "tabs": [{ "pillar": "<pillar key>", "items": [..] }] }: 'The work' with one tab per pillar (name and colour come from the pillar). Each item is a carousel { "title", "slides": [{ "src", "alt" }] } (click opens every slide) or a reel { "title", "cover", "video" } (plays silently on loop while on screen). Tabs with no items are hidden. Optional 'caseTitle' + 'case' [..paragraphs]: 'The case' block after the body; the first paragraph is shown large (the brief), the rest as normal text. Optional 'results': one block or a list of blocks (one per channel), each { "title", "lead", "stats": [{ "value", "label", "note" }], "chart": { "title", "bars": [{ "label", "value" (number), "display" }] }, "aside": [..], "more": { "title", "stats": [..] } }: Results section after 'The work'. Only verified numbers. Project-level: optional 'lead' replaces the subtitle under the title on the case study page only (the card keeps 'subtitle'); optional 'heroStats' { "title", "stats": [..] } shows key numbers under 'What I did'. Project-level 'brand' (e.g. "#D62E45"): the case study page gets red/white brand accents (title, serif headline, 'The case' panel, tabs, numbers, buttons).
_help.stats: Numbers banner. Only use verified numbers. Shown after the story (or in the cover spot if there's no cover). Empty [] removes the banner completely.
_help.gallery: Images or videos after the story. Files go in assets/images/projects/<id>/. Each item: { "src", "alt", "width", "height" }. Layout is automatic: wide images (width/height >= 1.3) take a full row, square or portrait images pair up two per row, in the order listed. Keep portraits in even groups between banners so none is left alone.
_help.todo: Any value that starts with 'TODO' is shown on the site with a dashed outline, so you can spot what still needs writing.
_help.proposal: Optional 'proposal' { "eyebrow", "title", "text", "url", "cta" }: a closing section with a live preview of a separate page (e.g. a brand proposal) and a button to open it.
_help.facts: sector / role / dates / location fill the info row. Rules: 'dates' = year only (e.g. 2023, or 2024 – present); 'location' = City, Country. Leave an item out to hide it.
_help.comingSoon: Set "comingSoon": true to show the card with a lock and 'Coming soon' (not clickable, and skipped by 'Next project').

projects.title: Casalia
projects.subtitle: Guest experience, brand and content for a fast-growing startup renting upscale apartments in Buenos Aires.
projects.role: Social Media Strategist, promoted from Area Coordinator

story.subhead: At Casalia I worked both sides: the guest at the door and the guest on the screen.
body: Casalia offered upscale apartments in Buenos Aires for short and mid-term stays, a young brand growing fast. I began on the guest side as Area Coordinator, learning first-hand what a great stay should feel like.

Then I moved into brand and content. I set the content strategy and calendar, and led creative production, styling each shoot to create a unique narrative for every home. I also shaped the digital touchpoints, from landing pages to social, so the whole journey felt effortless.

proposal.title: Home, for however long.
proposal.text: Beyond the work I delivered, I sketched where I believed the brand could go: a calmer, more editorial Casalia built around one idea, that a stay should never feel temporary. This landing page is that vision, from tone of voice to booking flow. Stay names, ratings and reviews are illustrative.

projects.title: Bonafacha
projects.subtitle: The streetwear label I founded in 2020 and launched in La Paz, Bolivia and Buenos Aires, Argentina.
projects.location: La Paz, Bolivia · Buenos Aires, Argentina

story.subhead: A streetwear label born in 2020: minimal, timeless pieces and accessories, designed to pair effortlessly with any look.
body: Bonafacha grew out of my love for fashion and a simple idea: accessories with a clean, minimal look that work for every occasion. We launched in La Paz, Bolivia, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, as a team of two, with me leading the strategic and creative side.

We reached monthly sales of more than 90 accessories and sold more than 1,000 garments a year, with one goal behind every drop: inspire each person to discover and express their own style, whatever the occasion.

pillars.title: Brand identity & design
pillars.text: I shaped every visual and strategic side of Bonafacha: a clean, pared-back identity built to carry the essence of the brand.

pillars.title: Digital strategy
pillars.text: Wear to Differ became the concept behind our digital campaigns, built to position the label in the market and drive sales.

pillars.title: Art direction & photography
pillars.text: Every image was shot by me and the team. Each session shows the creative process, from art direction to working the camera.
